name: axiam/axiam-sdk
description: Official PHP client SDK for AXIAM IAM

suggest.ext-ffi: Required for the §23 OPAQUE client (loginOpaque/opaqueEnrollment), which binds libaxiam_opaque_ffi — CONTRACT §23.1 forbids an SDK from implementing OPAQUE itself. Without ext-ffi, opaqueAvailable() reports false and the OPAQUE login path is unavailable; every other feature is unaffected. The shared library is NOT a Composer package: download the asset for your platform from https://github.com/ilpanich/axiam/releases and put it on the system library path, or set AXIAM_OPAQUE_LIBRARY to its full path.
suggest.ext-grpc: Enables the gRPC transport for checkAccess/batchCheck on long-running runtimes (Swoole/RoadRunner). REST-only fallback is used automatically when absent.
suggest.grpc/grpc: Required alongside ext-grpc for gRPC support; the SDK never fatals without it as long as extension_loaded('grpc') gates every gRPC class reference.
suggest.google/protobuf: Runtime classes (Google\Protobuf\Internal\Message) the committed src/Grpc/Gen/* stubs extend; only loaded behind the same extension_loaded('grpc') guard as grpc/grpc, so never required on a REST-only runtime.

scripts-descriptions.grpc-gen: Regenerate the committed protobuf message stubs in src/Grpc/Gen/ from proto/ (requires protoc on PATH).
